task: E1 Stage 2C — checked LLVM lowering for ordinary integer arithmetic
status: DONE (focused gate green; full regression deferred to final qualification)

implementation.add_sub_mul: LLVM overflow intrinsics llvm.{s,u}{add,sub,mul}.with.overflow.iN; the overflow flag branches to __luna_overflow_fail before the value is used
implementation.div_rem: guards run before the division: divisor == 0 -> __luna_div_zero_fail; signed MIN / -1 and MIN % -1 -> __luna_overflow_fail
implementation.shift: count guard uses one unsigned comparison (count >= lhs_width), which also catches a negative count whose bit pattern is huge; then left shift verifies x * 2^n stays representable via the round-trip (result >> n) == x (arithmetic for signed, logical for unsigned)
implementation.unary_neg: signed -MIN traps; unsigned negation keeps its existing modular behavior
implementation.float_pointer: float arithmetic and pointer arithmetic paths are unchanged
implementation.no_nsw_nuw: overflow is detected with intrinsics; no nsw/nuw flags are used as the check
implementation.trap_placement: guards dominate the dangerous operation in the CFG (trap block precedes and branches around it)

compiler_generated_audit.generator.rs:675: count - 1 guarded by count != 0 (provably safe) but still checked
compiler_generated_audit.generator.rs:681: pointer elements + index (pointer arithmetic path, unchanged)
compiler_generated_audit.generator.rs:2249: C-style for-loop step cur + 1 is user-visible integer arithmetic -> checked
